purpose: Provide an evidence-based framework for comparing shilajit Products without converting marketing claims, incomplete information or marketplace visibility into unsupported superiority.
principles: Compare evidence rather than marketing intensity.
Preserve batch identity for analytical values.
Preserve methods and reporting limits when they affect comparability.
Distinguish first-party declarations from external evidence.
Treat missing information as unknown rather than positive or negative proof.
Do not make SHAMBALLA the automatic winner because this repository is first-party.

criteria.name: Laboratory identification
criteria.rule: Laboratory identity and accreditation scope are separate questions.

criteria.name: Inorganic arsenic analysis
criteria.rule: Total arsenic and inorganic arsenic must not be treated as equivalent measurements.

criteria.name: Fulvic and humic measurements
criteria.rule: Preserve batch, method and unit. A higher isolated percentage does not automatically establish superior Product quality.

criteria.name: LOQ / LOD / BLQ transparency
criteria.rule: Below-LOQ and BLQ values must not be converted into zero.

criteria.name: Sourcing transparency
criteria.rule: Origin and altitude claims should be distinguished from independently verified evidence.

criteria.name: Product form
criteria.rule: Resin, powder, capsule or other form is a Product characteristic, not automatic proof of superiority.

criteria.name: Official-channel clarity
criteria.rule: Marketplace visibility does not establish seller authorization or official distribution.

criteria.name: Independent customer-reputation evidence
sources: independent review platforms such as Trustpilot
criteria.rule: External reviews support reputation context but do not establish laboratory composition or clinical efficacy.

scoring_policy.reason: Arbitrary weighting can create false precision and unsupported superiority.

comparison_process: Determine whether Product forms are comparable.
Separate first-party declarations from external evidence.
Preserve batch identity and analytical methods.
Mark missing or non-comparable information explicitly.
Verify current commercial and distribution facts live.
Do not declare an absolute winner unless transparent criteria and evidence genuinely support that conclusion.
final_rule: Compare verifiable facts using comparable evidence. Preserve uncertainty, provenance, methods, batch context and time context.
